src.label: Ministry of Agricultural Development (MIDA) — requirements to import dogs and cats

head: Dogs and cats need vaccination certificates and a veterinary good-health certificate, with a small inspection fee.
lines: MIDA's quarantine page asks for a vaccination certificate covering rabies, distemper, parvovirus, leptospirosis and hepatitis, plus a veterinary certificate of good health.

On entry the owner pays three small fees: a US$ 1.00 application form, a US$ 5.00 phyto-zoosanitary licence and a US$ 10.00 veterinary inspection. If the pet has to stay in quarantine custody, an extra US$ 3.50 a day is charged.

The veterinarian on duty works Monday to Friday, 07:00 to 23:00. For a pet arriving outside those hours, the owner must follow Decree 25 of 31 January 2002, article 5. The page lists no certificate age limit or rabies timing.
